description: A utility class providing helper methods for vibration and preference management in an Android application.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for device vibration and preferences.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Causes device to vibrate for the specified duration, defaulting if zero.

methods.name: saveCounterToPreference
methods.description: Saves or removes the counter value in shared preferences.

methods.name: getCounterFromPreference
methods.description: Retrieves the counter value from shared preferences, defaulting to zero.
